name: G K Consultants Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, G.K. Consultants Ltd is in the business of providing loans and advances to various corporates.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GKCL is registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company. It mainly provides for 
making loans and advances to industrial enterprises in India. Currently, the company
 is expanding into lending secured by movable 
and immovable assets—including gold, jewellery, vehicles, property, shares, debentures, and other financial instruments—and to conduct lending activities via loans, advances, hire-purchase, leasing, and other modes with or without security.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.89 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -41.6% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.04% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 483 days to 1,136 days
